title: SG-5.3 · Exporter builds frozen-only JSON export
summary: Add an exporter that builds the Export JSON from an ExportSource using only frozen contributions
description: Context: backend/internal/contribution already has the Export and ExportContribution types (export.go), the ExportSource interface with ListByRound and FrozenIDs (export_source.go), and FileStore.FrozenIDs (store.go). No exporter exists yet. Desired behavior: an Exporter builds an Export from the source, includes only contributions whose ids are frozen in the round snapshot, and returns an empty contributions list for an empty round. Why: the devion workseed handoff must receive only frozen contributions.
acceptance_criteria: Given a source with contributions A, B, C and frozen ids A and C, When Export is called, Then Contributions holds exactly A and C
Given a round with no frozen ids, When Export is called, Then Contributions is a non-nil empty slice that marshals to []
technical_constraints: Go package contribution only; depend only on ExportSource
No import of worker or execution packages
definition_of_done: Exporter implemented and unit tests pass
